result.title: Gaussian Process Bandits for Constraint Black Box Lever Optimization
result.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Includes results from a large-scale randomized controlled trial in a production environment
result.summary: Optimizing discrete allocation weights across competing segments of a shared budget is a fundamental challenge in resource-constrained, sequential decision-making environments. In practice, this optimization is often hindered by delayed, noisy, and aggregate feedback, alongside strict operational constraints on how frequently weights can be adjusted. Because of the resulting combinatorial action space and extreme data sparsity, classical multi-armed bandit algorithms that evaluate arms independently are rendered highly inefficient. To overcome these limitations, we propose a segmentation-agnostic approach utilizing Gaussian Process Upper Confidence Bound (GP-UCB) algorithms. By placing a Gaussian Process prior on the reward function, our method effectively shares information across neighboring configurations, drastically reducing the necessary exploration horizon. In this paper, we bridge the gap between theoretical bandit research and production-scale deployment. We first introduce a high-fidelity synthetic simulator to evaluate various kernel configurations under stationary, drifting, and reactive environments, identifying a composite Matérn + Linear kernel as the most robust choice for overcoming local noise and global shifts. Finally, we validate our findings through a large-scale Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT) in a live production environment. Our empirical results demonstrate that the GP-UCB approach delivers a statistically significant efficiency lift compared to a standard $\varepsilon$-greedy baseline, offering a highly practical solution for real-world black-box lever optimization.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文针对共享预算下离散分配权重的优化问题，用带复合 Matérn+Linear 核的 GP-UCB 在稀疏、延迟反馈下共享邻近配置信息，并通过合成模拟器与生产环境大规模 RCT 验证其相对 ε-greedy 的收益。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是广告/预算杠杆的序列分配与业务效率指标，不涉及视觉或多模态推理的状态表示、证据获取与停止决策；其高斯过程代理仅用于组合动作空间的探索效率，与 LVR 的推理状态更新和贡献分配缺少可核查的具体联系。
